name: Queen of The May
description: Join Seán Blackwell, B.A. for a talk on Our Lady as Queen of the May and the theological significance of her title. The day includes a talk, tea & coffee, and adoration.

name: Life in the Spirit Seminar
description: Join speakers such as Fr. John Mockler, Fr, John Keane, Fr. John McCarthy, Bernadette Goulding, Fr. Pat Corkery, Canon Donal O' Mahony, and more for our Life in the Spirit Seminar including talks, praise and worship, and silence.

name: A day with Jesus - Sacred Heart Retreat
description: Join Fr. John Mockler for a mini-retreat in preparation of the Feast of the Sacred Heart. With Eucharistic Adoration, confession, talks, and more, you will have a day with Jesus.
